cut.go.src:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	line := "color=deep=blue"

	before, after, found := strings.Cut(line, "=")
	fmt.Println(before, "|", after, "|", found)

	before, after, found = strings.CutLast(line, "=")
	fmt.Println(before, "|", after, "|", found)

	_, _, found = strings.Cut("no sign here", "=")
	fmt.Println(found)
}

tools_machine.go.src:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(strings.ToUpper("dash"))
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.Split("1-2-3", "-"))
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.Fields(" so  much  room "))
	fmt.Println(strings.Cut("photo.old.jpg", "."))
	fmt.Println(strings.CutLast("photo.old.jpg", "."))
	fmt.Println(strings.Repeat("=", 8))
	fmt.Println(strings.Join([]string{"a", "b", "c"}, ", "))
	fmt.Printf("%q\n", strings.TrimSpace("\t done \n"))
}
